gizmo.title: Papa kaʻina hana
gizmo.description: Nā ʻanuʻu i helu ʻia no ka hoʻopau ʻana i kekahi hana.

configure.title: Mea hōʻike ʻanuʻu
configure.description: Hōʻike i nā ʻanuʻu ma ke ʻano he lālani paʻapū o nā poʻo inoa e kaha ana i ka holomua. ʻAʻole hōʻike ʻia ka ʻike o nā ʻanuʻu ma kēia hoʻonohonoho.

configure.title: ʻAnuʻu o kēia manawa
configure.description: Ka ʻanuʻu e noho ai ka mea heluhelu, helu ʻia mai 1. Hōʻike ʻia nā ʻanuʻu ma mua he pau. Hoʻohana ʻia e ka mea hōʻike ʻanuʻu.
